## Selected Portfolio

### Pakistan Macroeconomic Dynamics

**Focus:** Macroeconomics, Econometrics, and Time-Series Analysis
**Tools:** VAR, SVAR, VECM, ARIMA, R, Stata, and Quarto

Applied macroeconometric methods to more than 44 quarters of data covering GDP, government spending, tax revenue, inflation, and the policy rate. Conducted stationarity testing, cointegration analysis, Granger causality, impulse-response analysis, and forecasting.

[View on GitHub](https://github.com/shadalishah/Macroeconomic-Time-Series-Analysis-VAR-SVAR-VECM){.btn .btn-primary .btn-lg}
:::

::: {.project-card}
### Pakistan E-Commerce Analytics

**Focus:** Customer Analytics, Segmentation, and Forecasting
**Tools:** Python, Pandas, K-Means, Prophet, and Statistical Analysis

Cleaned more than one million raw records into 584,524 validated transactions covering 115,326 customers. Applied customer segmentation, customer lifetime-value analysis, clustering, and sales forecasting to produce analytical findings and recommendations.

[View on GitHub](https://github.com/shadalishah/Pakistan-E-Commerce-Data-Analysis-2016-2018-){.btn .btn-primary .btn-lg}
:::

::: {.project-card}
### Advanced SQL Analytics with Google BigQuery

**Focus:** SQL Analytics, Customer Analysis, and KPI Reporting
**Tools:** SQL, Google BigQuery, CTEs, and Window Functions

Queried and segmented 50,000 customer records using SQL, Common Table Expressions, window functions, ranking methods, and data-quality checks. Produced customer-value analysis, churn insights, KPI summaries, and decision-ready outputs.

[View on GitHub](https://github.com/shadalishah/Basic-to-Advanced-SQL-Analytics-with-Google-BigQuery){.btn .btn-primary .btn-lg}
:::

::: {.project-card}
### Pakistan and Global Employment Analytics

**Focus:** Labour Economics, Policy Analysis, and Business Intelligence
**Tools:** Tableau, World Bank Data, Trend Analysis, and Forecasting

Analysed more than 57,500 employment observations across 183 countries. Examined long-term labour-market and gender trends, developed forecasts through 2030, and presented the findings through an interactive Tableau dashboard.

[View on GitHub](https://github.com/shadalishah/Pakistan-Global-Employment-Analytics-Tableau){.btn .btn-primary .btn-lg}
:::

::: {.project-card}
### NewsSense-BERT

**Focus:** Natural Language Processing, Text Analytics, and Transformer Research
**Tools:** Python, Pandas, NLTK, Scikit-learn, Named Entity Recognition, and BERT

Conducted an NLP and BERT feasibility study using 120,000 AG News training articles across four categories. Performed text profiling, preprocessing, n-gram analysis, Named Entity Recognition, and transformer-architecture planning.

[View on GitHub](https://github.com/shadalishah/NewsSense-BERT){.btn .btn-primary .btn-lg}
:::

**Tools:** Python, NLP, and RAG

Developed a banking-focused Retrieval-Augmented Generation project designed to retrieve relevant information and support structured responses to banking-related queries.
